# Code of conduct

This project should be a comfortable place to ask questions, report mistakes,
learn, contribute, and disagree respectfully.

Be specific and constructive. Assume good intent, but take responsibility for
the effect of your words and actions. Harassment, discrimination, threats,
personal attacks, doxxing, sexualized conduct, and sustained disruption are not
acceptable.

The maintainer may edit or remove contributions and restrict participation when
needed to keep project spaces safe and useful. If a concern cannot be raised
publicly, use the repository's private security-advisory channel and state that
the report concerns conduct. It will be handled as privately as practical, and
retaliation is not acceptable.

This is a short project-specific policy inspired by the
[Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
